name: carpsong-coda-deals-damage-equal-to-highest-life-water-animal-beast-in-graveyard
notes: Carpsong Coda deals damage equal to the highest life stat among water Animal and Beast ally cards in your graveyard (3). Pre-fix 0 damage ($highestLife undefined).

rulesClauses: Deal an amount of damage to target unit equal to the highest life stat among water element Animal and Beast ally cards in your graveyard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Carpsong Coda: the generated resolution handler ($highestLife) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
